integrity: The proof derives a bijection between AP-compatible doxastic relations and independent initial-segment cutoffs, then derives founded and epistemic subfamilies directly from Balbiani's frame definitions. The complete open-access primary article was inspected around the definitions, class inclusions, AP-compatibility construction, and appendix. Candidate-specific database and web searches found no equivalent finite-chain classification or factorial census.
scientific_limitations: The enumeration is for relations on a fixed finite chain and does not extend verbatim to arbitrary finite preorders. It is a structural frame census, not a new completeness theorem.
title: Factorial census of AP-compatible doxastic and epistemic chain frames
